title: Presence of God
definition: The presence of God is His nearness to His creation and His special nearness to His people in fellowship, worship, guidance, and covenant care.
summary: God is near to His people and dwells with them by grace.
christFocus: Jesus is Immanuel, God with us, and through Him believers have access to God's presence.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God is present everywhere, but Scripture also speaks of His special presence with His people. This presence brings fellowship, guidance, comfort, holiness, and joy.

Sin separates people from God's favorable presence, but Christ opens the way. Through His blood, believers draw near with confidence.

The story of Scripture moves toward God's dwelling with His redeemed people forever.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people feel abandoned or spiritually distant from God. The presence of God matters because it shows that the Lord's nearness is the greatest blessing of His people.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek God's presence through Christ. Practice prayer, worship, repentance, and Scripture with confidence that God draws near to His people.
